source.title: Delineation of Cañas Watershed in Cavite, Philippines Using Geographic Information System and Remote Sensing with Field Validation
source.workType: Undergraduate thesis, Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science

access.method: Official CvSU ILS search-index excerpt from the thesis retrieval PDF reviewed; the abstract identifies the study period and methods.
access.directPdfOpen: Timed out during this review; indexed abstract text only was available.

objectives: Delineate the Cañas River watershed using a Digital Elevation Model and Arc tool in ArcMap 10.2.1.
Conduct field surveys in different watershed areas to validate boundaries and the river network.
Describe watershed area, geographic location, drainage system, and existing land use.
reportedInputsAndMethods: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Digital Elevation Model for watershed delineation and terrain attributes.
2014 Landsat imagery for existing land-use determination.
Political boundary map overlay to identify municipalities and barangays within the watershed.
A handheld Ashtech Mobile Mapper Field 10 GPS for field validation of watershed boundaries and river networks; the abstract describes randomly collected coordinates near physical river networks.
sourceLimits: This thesis abstract is a watershed-mapping lead, not a downloadable waterbody boundary or channel centerline.
The indexed excerpt does not provide the GIS files, coordinate table, positional-accuracy results, or a complete station-to-channel crosswalk.
A land watershed boundary is not a municipal-water boundary, fish occurrence, or complete aquatic-species inventory.
The related 2017 fish-and-crustacean thesis cited by the CvSU 2022 shrimp paper remains a separate unretrieved source.

reuse.decision: Do not reproduce or publish any boundary, river network, map, or derived GIS layer from this thesis until the full source, item-specific reuse permission, and coordinate/data provenance have been reviewed.
